---
title: "Technical documentation"
---

OceanBench is a benchmarking tool to evaluate ocean forecasting systems against reference ocean analysis datasets (such as [GLORYS reanalysis](https://data.marine.copernicus.eu/product/GLOBAL_MULTIYEAR_PHY_001_030) and [GLO12 analysis](https://data.marine.copernicus.eu/product/GLOBAL_ANALYSISFORECAST_PHY_001_024)) as well as observations.

This documentation describes how to prepare and evaluate a challenger with the Python package `oceanbench`. The [definitions of the evaluation methods](/evaluation-methods/index.qmd) have their own page.

## Guides

- [Shape of the challenger dataset](shape-of-the-challenger-dataset/index.qmd)
- [Input datasets for OceanBench challenger evaluation](input-datasets-for-oceanbench-challenger-evaluation/index.qmd)
- [Units and time conventions of the input data](input-data-conventions/index.qmd)
- [1 degree track](one-degree-track/index.qmd)
- [Run OceanBench offline](run-offline/index.qmd)

- [Evaluate a challenger](api/evaluation/index.qmd)
